teachingQuestion: What turns a risk assessment into ongoing risk management?
focalInsight: Assessment informs a treatment decision; control assessment, monitoring, reporting, and improvement keep residual risk visible as conditions change.
title: Risk management is a continuous decision loop
caption: A control purchase is only one possible treatment step; the loop continues until ownership, evidence, and residual risk are reassessed.
altSummary: A six-stage loop goes from scope and analysis to treatment, control assessment, monitoring and reporting, then improvement and renewed scope.
textFallback: Scope the risk scenario and owner. Analyze likelihood, impact, existing controls, and uncertainty. Select avoidance, mitigation, transfer, or authorized acceptance. Assess control design and operation. Monitor changes and report residual risk. Improve assumptions or controls and start the analysis again when the context changes.
